content.title: YSR Congress Party Assists 18-Month-Old Boy with Spinal Muscular Atrophy
content.caption: The YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) promises financial assistance to an 18-month-old boy suffering from Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA), a rare genetic disorder requiring treatment costing nearly ₹1.5 crore.
